question: Please list the surgical treatments for Pilomatrix carcinoma.

supports.quote: Wide local excision has been recommended given the high rate of reoccurrence.
Mohs micrographic surgery may provide optimal treatment of this neoplasm given the ability to have 100% margin control.
There is no established treatment for wide local invasion and metastasis of the pilomatrix besides wide surgical resection.
Surgical excision with a wide margin is the current standard of care for chest wall pilomatrix carcinoma and is associated with the least recurrence

initial_executor.limitations: Evidence indicates no well-defined standards due to rarity; some treatments like radiation and chemotherapy are mentioned in case reports but not as primary surgical standards. Incision and curettement (e5) and complete surgical excision (e7) refer to benign pilomatricoma, not carcinoma.
